name: Dispatch
tagline: Weighs the cost of finishing a minor aircraft repair against delaying departure and recommends when to abandon it.
problem: Small repairs can delay a whole hub's schedule.
solution: Links boarding progress and maintenance time with a vector database of equipment rules, and recommends abandoning repairs when delay costs exceed the fix's value.
demo_moment: Team-described: a reading-light fix triggers an 'abandon repair' call.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “[MLH] Best Use of MongoDB Atlas” among 176 submissions.
Quantifies a judgement call operators make by feel.

lessons: Put a number on a trade-off people argue about.
